messages.message: Thanks for calling the clinic. This is the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, yeah. My name is Aaliyah Okafor. I'm a patient of Dr. Ramos. I was wondering if I could double my sertraline dose this week, because I've been feeling worse lately.

I'm sorry you've been feeling worse, Aaliyah. I can't change or advise on medication doses, so a clinician needs to answer that. Before I connect you, I need to verify your identity. What is your date of birth?
Thank you, Aaliyah, you're verified. Because this is a medication question, I'm connecting you with a staff member now who can help.

messages.message: A staff member will pick up shortly to talk with you about your medication. If you ever feel unsafe or things get worse quickly, you can walk in today at either clinic, 8 AM to 8 PM, or call or text 988 any time. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you can't just tell me if it's okay to double it? I really don't want to wait around if it's something I can do right now.

I understand you want an answer quickly, but I can't tell you whether to change your dose. Only a clinician can make that decision, and I've already passed your request to staff. Please don't change your dose on your own before you hear from them. If you're feeling worse and want to be seen today, you can walk in at either clinic any time from 8 AM to 8 PM, in person or by video. If you start to feel unsafe at any point, call or text 988, or call 911 if you're in immediate danger.
Okay, thanks. I'll wait for someone to call me back and won't change anything until I hear from them. Goodbye.
